about: How the game plays the Fairy type setting's new moves (fairy.json), which it doesn't have. Written by hand. A new move plays as a move the game has (`as`): its animation and battle messages, and its effect, unless `effectAs` names the move whose effect it plays instead, or `effect` is one of the port's (host/gen4.c's EFFECT_*). The move's own type, power, accuracy, PP, priority, targets, effect chance and flags are fairy.json's. `exact` says whether the effect is the move's own. `name` is the name the game shows, where the move's own is longer than its twelve letters (as the third generation's games ran a long name together).

Draining Kiss.note: Gives back three quarters of the damage (host/gen4.c).
